messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: High error rate for /v1/generate from multiple regions — automated alert (PAGER duty). Error class: TLS handshake timeout (net::ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR) — p99 4xx/5xx spike.

incident-bot: Link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/INC-1788888888

sara (oncall): ack — I'm on it, stepping into triage.

mike: seeing same. Digging into ingress logs now.

jordan: rolling tails: 'curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/health' shows TLS handshake timeout from eu-west-1: 
```
*connect to api.redwood.com port 443: Connection timed out*
*Failure when receiving server hello*
```

nina: also seeing DNS resolution flaps for api.redwood.com from our EU probe fleet. Some probes return 104.21.x.x, others time out.

kevin (infra): checking Cloudflare edge metrics — looks like partial degradation in EU anycast POPs. Cloudflare status indicates "partial network disruption affecting TLS termination" in the EU region. Posting CF incident link: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/eu-tls-edge-1788 (internal note, not a customer link).

mike: confirmed increased TLS handshake failures in ingress-gw logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T08:03:12Z] ingress-gw: tls_handshake_error client_ip=203.0.113.45 cf_pop=ams1 error=timeout
[2026-03-15T08:03:13Z] ingress-gw: tls_handshake_error client_ip=198.51.100.22 cf_pop=fra2 error=alert(104)
```

sara (oncall): customer impact? Any 5xx spike webhooks/enterprise routes?

nina: ~30% of EU requests failing fast, global ~5% increase in 500s. Affected: hosted API endpoints (text gen), customers in EU region on hosted plan. Dedicated still ok if traffic routed to non-EU.

jordan: quick mitigation idea — force routing for EU traffic to our us-west POPs via Cloudflare Traffic steering / Load Balancer geo policy to avoid the affected POPs. That will add ~100-150ms RTT, but reduces handshake failures.

kevin (infra): we have a traffic steering config named lb-api-geo. I can create a temporary rule to de-prioritize CF POPs in EU (ams/fra) and prefer us-west. Need 2 approvals for changes to global load balancer.

mike: +1, do it. We should also open a Cloudflare support ticket and request edge flush/reroute for affected PoPs.

sara (oncall): mike and kevin — coordinate. I'm escalating to incident commander (IC) role. I'll draft customer comms after we stabilize.

kevin (infra): applying temporary LB change now (will disable ams/fra priority). Command: 
```
# apply temporarily via infra-tooling
infractl lb update lb-api-geo --deprioritize-pop ams1,fra2 --ttl 60
```

ops-bot: Deploy event: infractl lb update started by kevin at 08:10 UTC — change id: CHG-1788-LB

mike: seeing traffic shift in our edge logs — new connections from us-west POPs incrementing. TLS handshake failures count dropping in eu probes that are now routed away.

nina: monitoring: EU error rate decreased from 32% -> 6% within 3 minutes of LB change. Good signal.

cloudflare-support: (via support) we've seen elevated error rates on a subset of EU POPs due to upstream routing flap. Engineers are investigating, requesting customer to apply traffic steering as interim. We'll provide updates in the CF ticket.

sara (oncall): good. Kevin, keep the LB change for 30m, then we'll reassess. Jordan, start drafting a short status update for customers: what happened, what we did, ETA for full recovery, recommended actions.

jordan: drafting. Suggested blurb: "We experienced partial CDN/TLS disruptions affecting EU connectivity to our API. As an interim mitigation we've rerouted EU traffic to alternate POPs which restored reachability. Cloudflare is investigating the root cause; we'll post updates. If you rely on EU-only Dedicated capacity, reach out to your CSM."

mike: also flagging internal Dedicated customers: some have pinned DNS/CF settings. We should contact dedicated-owners channel to verify dedicated tenants still healthy.

kevin (infra): CF updated ticket: engineers are performing BGP and kernel-level fixes on affected edges. They estimate 60-90 minutes for full recovery. They recommended we keep steering in place until they confirm.

nina: telemetry note: prefix-level cache cold-start on alternate POPs may cause slight latency bump & tokenization time increased. Watch per-token times.

sara (oncall): handoff note: I'm handing on-call to jordan at 08:15 UTC for incident management. Jordan — you own comms and final decisions; I'll remain available for escalation.

jordan: ack taking over. On-call handover: current mitigation in place (LB steering), CF investigating, error rates stabilized but latency > baseline for EU. Open actions: 1) keep LB steering 2) monitor CF ticket 3) notify CS + stakeholders 4) prepare postmortem.

mike: reached out to CS. They want a brief for customers. Also starting a thread with our top-10 EU customers to check if any have hit SLAs.

kevin (infra): scheduling auto-rollback at 09:00 UTC to remove steering if CF confirms fix. Rolling change id CHG-1788-LB.

cloudflare-support: update: engineers applied a fix to affected POPs, internal checks green. We'll continue monitoring propagation; please keep traffic steering in place for 30m, then test rollback.

jordan: noted. I'll run smoke tests after we remove steering: 
```
# test path
curl -sSf -D - https://api.redwood.com/v1/health | head -n 20
openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.com:443 -servername api.redwood.com
```

nina: performance alert: token latency up 20% during reroute window. Logging for cost impact flagged. We'll add to postmortem.

sara (oncall): nice work everyone. Jordan — please keep this thread for timeline of changes and final RCA notes. I'll join the postmortem.

jordan: will do. Closing the immediate page — setting incident severity to SEV2 (partial customer impact, mitigated). Full RCA and timeline to follow.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: SEV2 — mitigation applied (traffic steering) at 08:10 UTC; CF reported edge fixes at 08:36 UTC; rollback scheduled 09:00 UTC for verification.

mike: quick note for runbook: consider adding automatic health-based pop blacklisting when TLS handshake error rate > 8% for 2m. Cuts need for manual LB edits.

kevin (infra): filed infra ticket: INF-4822 'auto-pop-blacklist-on-tls-errors' — linking to incident.

jordan: thanks, pinging postmortem owner slot. We'll gather logs and customer impact metrics and circulate draft within 48h.

cloudflare-support: final: ticket will remain open until 12:00 UTC for post-incident verification. We'll let you know if anything else crops up.

sara (oncall): handing back to duty rotation: oncall clear for now. If we see regressions, re-escalate.
